criteria.method: Checked full generated start/prepare/command/executable/observation/resume/finish ID formulas, explicit fixed/inventory/request-output/unused adapted dispatch, runtime mounts and ControllerRuntime binding collisions in frozen constructor, same-slot Produced Text request to command, C request writer/identity router/strict observation branch, Rust strict canonical decoder and guarded execution dispatch. criteria.name: Actual admitted source kinds, consumed helpers, package exclusions and features
criteria.method: Compared actual 816 resolved Text/Tree classes to two admitted record inventories and frozen hydrate_reference/materialize_source_record_payload/lower_step, not digest-shaped names. Independently inspected both stage recipe JSONs: each original package copy binds original-package and original src/grammar.rs exclusion, and three exact helper source members are consumed per stage. Source-byte physical reconstruction belongs to separate criteria 7-8, not asserted here.

findings.title: Validate the canonical Mantle binary against its qualified semantic product
findings.producer: Both selected mantle-stage{1,2} recipe semantic_roots, key rust-unit:native:89a7b293d76f5212728bcf77d15b08740b1f5d2ec901f30756c8a38351432ad0:path+native#mantle@0.1.0:mantle:bin:build
findings.observed: sem.get('rust-unit:mantle',[]) is empty in each selected recipe; binary_is_exact_mantle_semantic_product=false twice, but mantle_root_and_consumer_failures ignores that flag. Independent exact-key inspection proves both current binaries do match, so the selected product is not claimed broken.
findings.consequence: A future/altered selected binary that remains an Executable root and the --help executable can pass the final CLEAR tally without being the declared Mantle semantic Rust unit; current report cannot certify this required handoff.
findings.action: Derive the unique actual rust-unit key for path+native#mantle@0.1.0:mantle:bin:build, compare its exact Produced output with the binary export, and count a mismatch or nonunique/missing key as a static failure; retain previous reports and rerun on the unchanged subject.

observations_not_blockers: Final graph report's 14013 raw ControllerSpec word flags use outer controller-input-N scope; full template report checks actual generated lexical scopes and reports zero corrected issues.
StageX 132 source/patch lineage edges are authenticated source admission, not execution-produced dependency edges.
Two Linux-header commands consume the exact projected bin/make Executable from the Make installation Tree; this does not claim observed runtime image bytes.
Retained 71 native unused-input step diagnostics do not establish a missing required recipe input, and do not establish minimal input authority.
The graph inventory's 35 native dependency-unreachable steps remain executed in declared recipe order.
